tagline: Flies before every turn, and hits hardest the moment he lands

featuredCards.title: Able To Leap Tall Buildings In A Single Bound
featuredCards.caption: Land him on a space that touches two zones and his free flight at the start of every turn doubles.

featuredCards.title: Momentous Shift
featuredCards.caption: His passive flies him before he even acts, so when he swings, this 3 is a 5.

featuredCards.title: Heroic Interception
featuredCards.caption: The rescue, or the throw. He grabs the fighter beside him and carries them up to four spaces, wherever he wants them.

featuredCards.title: Last Son of Krypton
featuredCards.caption: Win the fight and he draws and heals. Eighteen health that keeps coming back is a lot to chew through.
